**Finding: compliant (at fallback) — Rule T4C, Termination for convenience**

Section 17(b) gives Sparkling an unconditional right to terminate at any time on 90 calendar days' written notice, with no early-termination fee or penalty. Garman has no convenience termination right anywhere in the Agreement — Section 17(c) is limited to insolvency and uncured material default, and the Section 10 maintenance terms (renewable one-year) contain no vendor cancellation right.

This lands squarely on the playbook fallback (customer exit on 60–90 days' notice, no fee) and exceeds the fallback on the vendor side (no vendor convenience right at all, versus fallback tolerance of end-of-term exit on 90 days). No redline proposed.

Noted but not flagged: the preferred position's 30-day notice and express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees are absent — a refund only appears on termination for Garman's default (p0128). These are optional asks if Section 17 is reopened commercially.
